`interface IResourceAnimationReader`<br/>
**Known subtypes:** [`ApngResourceAnimationReader`](/reference/resources/apngresourceanimationreader/), [`GifResourceAnimationReader`](/reference/resources/gifresourceanimationreader/), [`WebpResourceAnimationReader`](/reference/resources/webpresourceanimationreader/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.animation` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [IResourceAnimationReader.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/animation/IResourceAnimationReader.java)

Reads every frame of an animated image file into a `ResourceAnimation`.

## Description

Give it to [`AnimatedResourceDecoder.create`](/reference/resources/animatedresourcedecoder/#AnimatedResourceDecoder-factory-create) from the [`IResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/iresourceformat/) of your format.
Compose the frames on a [`ResourceAnimationCanvas`](/reference/resources/resourceanimationcanvas/) when the format stores them as partial updates.

## Method details

<a id="IResourceAnimationReader-method-read"></a>

### read

`ResourceAnimation read(InputStream stream)` <span class="joid-qualifier">abstract</span>

JOID calls it on a loading thread, once per file: read the whole stream and return its frames, each a full image of the animation size.
Throw `IOException` or `IllegalArgumentException` when the file is damaged; the resource then fails.
